summary: Implemented window title support in Rich. Added ControlType.SET_WINDOW_TITLE (rich/segment.py), an OSC 0 format `\x1b]0;{title}\x07` and Control.title classmethod (rich/control.py), Console.set_window_title(title) that writes only when is_terminal (rich/console.py), a CHANGELOG Unreleased "Added" entry, and test_control_title in tests/test_control.py. Nothing was run or committed; the legacy Windows renderer ignores the new control type, so titles are not set on that path.
